title: Special Topics in African American and Africana Studies; Jazz as a Cultural Art Form
description: This course examines the creators, historical innovators, and evolution of the music known as Jazz from the standpoint of: historical, social, political, and economic conditions in the U.S. (past and present). National policy as it impacts upon the economics of popular American music, European classical music, and the music known as Jazz, and the artists who play it is the focus of the course.
